name: Loco Shell
description:
A Poco-style app launcher that replaces Show Apps: filter apps by icon color, search from the bottom, and pick emoji with Emoji Kitchen stickers. Plus One Hand Operation+-style edge swipes that open a panel of configurable quick tools (swipe on to the middle of the screen for the launcher).

Clipboard: inserting an emoji into apps without an input method, and pasting a sticker, go through the clipboard (your previous clipboard text is restored after an emoji). Network: Emoji Kitchen sticker images are downloaded from Google's servers (www.gstatic.com) when you open an emoji's stickers, and cached locally.
